service: Procurement under the PRODECI-TURIKUMWE community development project (ONPRA)
title: Manuel de Passation de Marchés (MPM) – PRODECI-TURIKUMWE
authority: Ministère de l'Intérieur, du Développement Communautaire et de la Sécurité Publique / Office National de la Protection des Réfugiés et Apatrides (ONPRA)
locator: Sommaire; §3.2 Acteurs de la passation des marchés et leurs responsabilités (ONPRA, UGP, SPM/SPMJ, commissions); §3.3 seuils de revue a priori; §4.1.2 Appel d'Offres National
finding: 103-page project procurement manual assigning roles to ONPRA, the project management unit (UGP), the procurement specialist (SPM) and procurement commissions, with thresholds, the World Bank no-objection sequence (SPM prepares, submits for non-objection, then transmits for final validation) and method-by-method steps for AOI, AON, demande de cotation and consultant selection.

authority: Ministerio de Hacienda, Economía y Planificación (published by Oficina de Información y Prensa de Guinea Ecuatorial)
locator: Arts. 7-9 (contingency), 12-16 (manifest registration/validation), 19-26 (declaration, inspector assignment, selectivity channels, payment, release)
finding: Ministerial order setting the sequence manifest registration (48h before arrival, sea) -> electronic validation -> temporary deposit -> declaration -> admission and inspector assignment with green/blue/yellow/red selectivity channels -> payment to Treasury via bank -> release; names carriers, declarants, Dirección General de Aduanas, administradores principales, inspector.
limitations: A legal text (ministerial order) rather than an operational manual; no caseworker instructions beyond the channel logic; hosted on the government press site, not the ministry's. The other national lead (CAADP page) only reported a training workshop.

service: Results-based financing (FBR) of health institutions: contracting, verification and payment

locator: Ch. IV (actors by level: IS, UAS, DDS, UC, AEV with task lists), Ch. VI Système de vérification, Ch. VII.2.1 Délais de paiement (38 jours ouvrables), VII.2.2 (26 jours)
finding: 94-page manual assigning roles (health institutions sign results-purchase contracts with the DDS, the DDS with the Minister, the central UC compiles payment requests, an external verification agency AEV verifies quantity/quality/community data and co-signs invoices) and a step-timed payment circuit: SIS report 5 days -> AEV quantitative verification and provisional invoice 14 days -> definitive invoice 1 day -> validation 1 day -> transmission 1 day -> UC compilation 5 days -> expenditure controller 3 days -> engagement/liquidation/ordonnancement/virement 7 days.
limitations: 2013 edition; the FBR scheme was donor-supported and current applicability is not established; narrative task lists rather than swimlanes.

service: Assignment of agency numbers (代行機関番号) to medical-claims processing agencies used by health insurers
title: 代行機関番号付番申請における事務処理上の手順
authority: 保険者協議会中央連絡会 (insurers' liaison council), hosted by 厚生労働省 (MHLW); MHLW 保険局医療費適正化対策推進室 is an actor
locator: 1. 申請 ①-⑤; 2. 受付等 (checks a-e, ⑤' return branch, ⑥ transfer to MHLW); 3. 通知 ⑦-⑧; 4. 周知 ⑨
finding: Two-page numbered flow: applicant agency prepares form 1-1 and asks the insurer to relay; insurer prepares request letter 1 and asks its central body for request letter 2; the council secretariat checks the form, both letters and the agency's website disclosure rule, keeps a reception register, returns incomplete applications (⑤'), and forwards originals to MHLW's Medical Cost Optimisation Office, which files them, updates the number register and website list and issues the decision notice (form 4) back via the council.
limitations: Authored by a non-ministerial liaison council although published on MHLW's site with MHLW steps; 2008; narrow back-office function. Found via one targeted search after the saved leads were public-facing or 403/404.

service: Classification of protected areas (proposal procedure)

limitations: A government decree, not an internal manual; the passport decree-law in the same issue (Art. 61) only mandates DNRN to draft a passport procedures manual, which is not published. Gazette hosted by Ministry of Justice.

authority: Direction générale de l'énergie et du climat (DGEC) and Direction générale de la prévention des risques (DGPR), Ministère de la Transition écologique

service: Official travel authorization, advances and vouchers for Executive Branch employees
title: Executive Order No. 422 – Republic of Palau Travel Policies and Procedures for the Executive Branch of the National Government
authority: Office of the President, Republic of Palau (Bureau of National Treasury / Division of Finance and Accounting Travel Section administers)
document_date: Revised April 2019 (EO signed April 2019; original effective 12 August 2001)
locator: §202 Responsibilities for Preparation and Approval (202.1-202.6), §203 Instructions for completing TA form ROP-1020, §204 Routing and Distribution of TAs, §403 Travel Advances Procedures, §602 Travel Voucher
finding: 70-page procedures document: the requestor (supervisor or bureau director) prepares the TA; minister endorses and approves up to $2,500, President approves above $2,500 and all travel during a freeze; Director of Bureau of Public Service System prepares/approves recruitment, repatriation and transfer TAs after checking personnel actions; Minister of Health approves medical referrals; TAs go to the Travel Section at least 5 days before travel and BNT-DF&A may decline non-compliant TAs; field-by-field form instructions, routing, advances and voucher settlement.
